description: Fungal diseases, common diseases, aerial encounters, and navigational hazards.

entries.title: Fungal Implant Diseases
entries.summary: Airborne and undercloud fungi infect creatures through spores, wounds, and parasitic growths that alter movement, vitality, and behavior.
body: Sporeblight causes spreading respiratory and neurological illness. Skyfungus Growth produces visible parasitic structures. Undercloud Rot attacks tissue in damp lower layers. Aerial Mycosis thrives in flying fauna, Haze Cap Disease clouds perception, and Siphon Fungus drains a host to feed itself.
Treatments vary by organism and may involve isolation, removal, antifungal preparations, clean air, magical aid, or destroying contaminated material.

sections.heading: Legacy Disease Procedures
body: The source assigns saving throws, staged symptoms, damage, and treatment checks to six diseases. Numerical procedures require conversion.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Fungus Implant Diseases for Land and Air Fauna

entries.title: Diseases of Land and Sky
entries.summary: Kaysender's people and livestock face illnesses spread by clouds, winds, falls, dragons, crops, darkness, and parasites.
body: Cloud Fever and Windblight spread through exposed communities and travel routes. Skyfall Wasting follows trauma and exposure. Draconic Pox is associated with draconic contact, Rotroot Disease attacks agricultural systems, Gloom Taint emerges from dark corrupted regions, and Marshmaggot Rot thrives in wet settlements and livestock.
Disease control depends on quarantine, clean water and air, herbal and alchemical treatment, careful disposal, and identifying whether an outbreak is ordinary, fungal, magical, or environmental.

sections.heading: Legacy Disease Procedures
body: The source gives staged fifth-edition symptoms, saving throws, and treatments for seven diseases. Conversion is required.

sourceRefs.outlineTitle: Diseases of the Land: Livestock and Populace

entries.title: Random Aerial Encounters
entries.summary: Travel through Kaysender can bring wildlife, weather, wreckage, traders, patrols, pirates, strange islands, and major supernatural threats.
body: The source separates ordinary aerial events from advanced and dangerous encounters. Results range from navigational complications and useful discoveries to hostile fleets, enormous creatures, magical disturbances, and situations that can redirect an expedition.
Encounter selection should reflect altitude, route safety, faction territory, weather, traffic, and the condition of the traveling vessel.

sections.heading: Legacy Encounter Tables
body: The source provides small and advanced random tables. Their dice procedures are preserved for later conversion.

entries.title: Aerial Navigational Hazards
entries.summary: Minor route hazards can damage ships, scatter formations, exhaust crews, conceal threats, or force costly detours.
body: Common hazards include unstable winds, dense clouds, lightning, debris, magical turbulence, poor visibility, sudden temperature shifts, and living obstacles. Even minor hazards become serious when supplies, morale, or hull condition are already poor.
Pilots, navigators, engineers, and lookouts must coordinate responses rather than treating each danger as a single isolated check.

sections.heading: Legacy Hazard Table
body: The source provides a minor aerial navigational hazard table and associated checks and consequences. Conversion is required.
